errors.evidence: The blue line's value in 2013 is approximately 2.8%; it is visibly above the purple dashed line which is at 2.6%. The description incorrectly uses the value of the purple average line.
The value of the blue line in 2020 is approximately 6.9%, as it is visibly above the blue dashed line at 6.3%. The stated value of 5.8% is incorrect.
The description states that the purple line falls to ~0.4% in 2008. However, in 2008 the value is approximately 3.5%. The value of ~0.4% corresponds to the year 2009.
The description incorrectly refers to the purple average line as 'durchgehende' (solid/continuous), but it is a dashed line ('gestrichelte').
